visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of a long-necked, slender-bodied marine reptile with distinct, webbed limbs.
visual_logic.environment: High-contrast 'Silvery-White' horizon light reflecting off a calm Triassic sea.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: DUSK_SILHOUETTE to emphasize the 'seal-like' neck-to-torso transition.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: An elongated head with a visible 'underbite' or jagged teeth-fringe profile in the silhouette.

pose: Resting on a jagged limestone rock in a 'sun-basking' pose, highlighting the long neck arched upward and the clear definition of the webbed feet.
negative_constraints: No internal detail; the silhouette should clearly distinguish between the fleshy tail and the distinct limbs.
